Last night, around 10 PM, my Bullet 350 suddenly broke down while I was riding through Worli. I needed to get back to Goregaon, but the bike just wouldn’t start due to a technical fault. Babu Bhai arrived along with his helper Shalam, and both of them genuinely tried every possible method to get my bike started. When it was clear that the bike wouldn’t run, they didn’t just leave me stranded. Instead, they promised to tow my bike all the way to Goregaon. I took a cab and reached home by 11:15 PM, and these two incredible men reached Goregaon with my bike by 11:25 PM, safely and without any complaints.

I am honestly beyond grateful. In times like these, you realize how rare it is to meet genuinely good-hearted people. I didn’t just get my bike helped — I met two humans who reminded me that kindness still exists.

Thank you so much, Babu Bhai and Shalam.
Your honesty, dedication, and willingness to help during someone’s worst moment truly deserve appreciation.

If anyone ever needs reliable, quick, and genuine two-wheeler roadside assistance or repair service around Worli or nearby areas — I 100% recommend BR Auto.

Respect and gratitude to both of you. 🙏❤️
